{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Define sentinel value
sentinel_value = -999.0

# Filter out rows with sentinel values and invalid entries
valid_baseline = df['biomarker_baseline'][(df['biomarker_baseline'] != sentinel_value) & (df['biomarker_baseline'] >= 0) & (~df['biomarker_baseline'].isna())]

# Compute mean of valid baseline biomarker values
mean_baseline = valid_baseline.mean()

# Check that we have valid data
assert len(valid_baseline) > 0, "No valid baseline values found."

mean_baseline"}
